_help: Quality gates (Release Relay pipeline files version 13), all optional. Example: { "scan": { "failAtPriority": 2 }, "coverage": { "minimumPerClass": 75, "minimumOrgWide": 75 }, "tests": { "requireForApex": true } }. scan: the scan fails when any finding has priority failAtPriority or higher (1 is highest, 5 lowest). coverage: a validation that ran tests fails when a deployed Apex class or trigger is below minimumPerClass percent; minimumOrgWide is checked only when the validation ran RunLocalTests or RunAllTestsInOrg. tests.requireForApex: a validation of a release with Apex that would run no tests fails before anything is sent. scan.json and validate.json record "gates": { file, passed, failures }. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Read from the pipeline's own commit (the default branch).
